name: save-boot-11c-battle-actor-slots
description: #110 attempt 1: the menu slot follows the party member whose command menu opens. From "stats-battle" (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; a random battle in md1_1): wait until the widget id reads 1 (open_wait), 30 frames, mark "first" (actor1: the slot then, 0-2). Take Attack on the default target: Circle every 30 frames (held 4) until the widget id reads 0 (target_wait), 20 frames, Circle every 30 frames until it reads 0xffff (closed_wait). Then wait until it reads 1 again (next_wait; the next ready member's menu) and 30 frames: the slot must differ from the mark (actor_dir, sign only), and actor (0-2) is its value at the end. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.

widget.description: g_BattleMenuModalWidgetId (s16 as u16; config/symbols.battle.txt 0x800F3896; src/battle/battle3.c): the battle menu widget taking input. -1 (0xffff) none (BattleMenuInit), 1 the command menu (Cancel from a sub-menu returns to 1), 0 target selection (BattleMenuUpdate runs the targeting code when it reads 0), 3/7/0x18/0x1A/0x1B sub-menus.
